title: PF1 Improved Energy Drain
description: Completes the Pathfinder 1e energy drain / negative level rules that the system leaves to the GM. Tracks each source of negative levels as its own instance with its own kind and lifecycle: temporary levels that expire on their own, bestowed levels that trigger a Fortitude save after 24 hours (fail = permanent level loss), and static levels tied to a worn/active source. Adds the death check at negative levels ≥ Hit Dice, a manual-application prompt, an @EnergyDrain[...] enricher, and a module API.
